unknown_rule: All null monetary measures mean UNKNOWN, never0. Known model cost is not full budget.
double_count_rule: New invoice replaces matching proxy or only proven uncovered residual; reserve/lease/capital/opportunity share a resource counterfactual.
donor_rule: Internal migrated revenue/old product delta already included. Only uncovered signed donor contribution separately; economic loss is not cash payment.
